description: This file defines the RequestException class within the GuzzleHttp library, specifically handling exceptions related to HTTP requests. It includes methods for wrapping, creating, and retrieving request and response information related to exceptions.

classes.name: RequestException
classes.description: Handles exceptions related to HTTP request errors, storing the request, response, and contextual information.

methods.name: wrapException
methods.description: Wraps a generic Throwable in a RequestException if it isn't one already.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RequestException instance with a detailed message based on the response status.

methods.name: obfuscateUri
methods.description: Obfuscates sensitive information in the URI, such as username and password.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request object that caused the exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks whether a response was received.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Retrieves auxiliary contextual data about the error from the handler.
